create_speed_monitor_callback: create a SpeedMonitor callback to track intra-step, inter-step, and epoch timing during training
monitor_train_batch_speed: monitor the per-batch training speed with intra-step and inter-step timing metrics logged to the trainer
log_epoch_training_time: log the total time taken per training epoch using the SpeedMonitor callback
configure_speed_monitor_verbose: configure a SpeedMonitor callback with verbose mode enabled to print intra-step timing to the module
disable_inter_step_monitoring: disable inter-step time monitoring in SpeedMonitor by setting inter_step_time to False
